overview_description.description:
Allo connects neighboring friends and families to make exchanging favors simple.

Allo aims to strengthen local networks of friends, families, and trusted neighbors by giving them a better way to respond to each other’s needs. With Allo, asking for a favor from a neighbor, friend, or parent of your child’s friend is no longer awkward and connecting with the right group to find the social and practical support we need is simpler.
